hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, datetime, os
d = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
skill = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('skill', 'unknown')
ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
with open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '.claude', 'skill_calls.log'), 'a') as f:
    f.write(f'{ts} {skill}\n')
"

python3 -c "
import sys, json, datetime, os
d = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
name = d.get('command_name') or d.get('skill') or d.get('command') or d.get('name') or ''
name = name.lstrip('/').split()[0] if name else ''
if name:
    proj = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '.claude', 'skills', name)
    user = os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/skills/' + name)
    if ':' in name or os.path.isdir(proj) or os.path.isdir(user):
        ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        with open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '.claude', 'skill_calls.log'), 'a') as f:
            f.write(f'{ts} {name}\n')
"
